verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a built-in AI capability is a single line about using AI to help write or edit content. That is content assistance, not delegating tasks to an agent-like assistant. The MCP server connects Trello to external AI tools, so it is not a built-in assistant, and the automation evidence does not mention AI. Missing for 10: a documented built-in AI assistant that accepts and carries out delegated tasks (creating or moving cards, planning work), detail on what the AI feature can do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
